metadata.title: Monochromatic Teal Portrait with Script Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, soft-focus portrait of a bearded man in profile, rendered in a deep monochromatic teal-green palette, featuring elegant, white, hand-drawn script typography positioned in the negative space to the right.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast white script against dark teal background
Soft-focus facial features versus sharp, thin-line lettering
Subject gaze directed away from the text toward the left edge
Vertical stack of text balancing the horizontal weight of the face
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused lighting on the face
Deep shadow transition on the right side of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the forehead and neck.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye, which is the sharpest point of the photographic element.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright highlights of the face on the left, moves across the bridge of the nose to the white script on the dark right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, shadowed area on the right provides a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal/cyan (#004d4d) acting as the shadow and mid-tone base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cyan/white (#e0ffff) for highlights on the face.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white (#ffffff) for the sharp typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between the deep shadows and the bright script.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with exaggerated ascenders and descenders
letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight with very thin hairlines
Extended horizontal flourishes on terminal strokes
Interconnected characters with a fluid, handwritten feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters feature long, sweeping crossbars
Descenders curve back under the word in a decorative swash

typesetting.alignment: center-aligned relative to the text block

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the darkest negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script style used for all text to maintain a signature-like quality.
graphicDevices: Small decorative squiggles/flourishes above and below the text block

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the personal, hand-drawn feel of the original.
Captures the high-contrast thin lines and decorative swashes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up profile portrait of a man with a beard and wavy hair, lit from the side to create deep shadows. Apply a monochromatic teal-cyan duotone filter. The right side of the image should be almost entirely dark teal negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom white script lettering in the upper right dark area. Use thin, elegant lines with long horizontal flourishes. Stack the text vertically.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic teal?
Is the text pure white and sharp against the background?
Does the script have a hand-drawn, signature-like quality?
Is the subject's face in soft focus compared to the text?

adjustableVariables: Amount of grain/noise in the photograph
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title text
Any logos or record label branding
Exact facial features of the specific individual
postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleeding outside the teal spectrum
Ensure script flourishes do not obscure the face
Verify the white text is legible but delicate
Confirm the composition feels weighted toward the left
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Duotone + Soft Focus Portrait + Signature Script Overlay
